answer: We model a protocol where agents post basalt security bonds of staking collateral alongside zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs to establish unique identity. An adversary deploying a gale of Sybil identities triggers a subgame-perfect slashing matrix, propagating a liquidation ripple that forces the expected utility of identity multiplication to remain strictly negative. Thus, since delay cost scales quadratically, honest execution constitutes a robust Nash equilibrium.
